name: Andrew Lass
headline: Senior Cloud Security & Infrastructure Engineer
summary: Senior Cloud Security and Infrastructure Engineer with 12+ years architecting, securing, and automating enterprise-scale multi-cloud environments on AWS (expert), Azure, and OCI. Proven track record designing DMZ perimeter architecture, multi-account governance frameworks, and everything-as-code CI/CD pipelines — at SAP Concur across 8+ global production environments and at Nintendo of America across 100+ AWS accounts and 20+ Azure subscriptions. Known for delivering at scale: Gateway Load Balancer-fronted DMZ re-architectures, OpenTofu firewall fleet migrations, FIPS-validated FedRAMP designs, and policy-as-code compliance automation for PCI DSS, SOC 2, and SOX. Always building. Always automating.

AWS (EC2, ECS Fargate, Lambda, Auto Scaling)

experience.title: Senior Cloud Security & Infrastructure Engineer
bullets: Designed and led DMZ 2.0 — a multi-region Gateway Load Balancer-fronted FortiGate re-architecture replacing the legacy AWS perimeter across all commercial environments (Integration, US2, EU2, APJ1, Fabian US, Fabian EMEA); SARB-approved February 2023, final cutover August 2025.

Obtained five-board governance approval (SARB, SCORE, CACB, FIPS review, SDLC pen-test) for centralized FortiManager including a FIPS 140-validated design for the CTE-3 FedRAMP environment; onboarded all seven environments in under six months.

Led OpenTofu migration for the FortiGate fleet — bootstrapped the opentofu-deployer repository, authored 108 pull requests migrating from CloudFormation/Ansible to declarative IaC; first production cutover (FortiOS 7.4.11) completed May 2026.

Primary owner of Ansible-based firewall-pipeline managing the entire FortiGate fleet; executed continuous FortiOS upgrades 6.4 through 7.6, certificate lifecycle automation, password rotation, and IMDSv2 compliance hardening.
Closed 1,400+ vulnerability tickets (Tenable, AWS Inspector, Cloud Custodian, Orca, FIM, SIEM) across all environments — approximately 58% of all assigned work over five years.
Implemented IPv6 dual-stack across commercial and FedRAMP (CTE-3) environments totaling 124 tracked tickets; executed full CTE-3 reimplementation after initial rollout required revision.

Authored mcs-network-skills Claude Code plugin (11 skills) encoding five years of operational knowledge into agentic automation for vulnerability reporting, FortiGate health checks, change-request drafting, and team review.

Built everything-as-code CI/CD platform (GitHub Enterprise + AWS CodeBuild/CodePipeline) for PR-gated deployment of AWS infrastructure and FortiGate security configurations across 8+ global production environments; 795 PRs authored and 836 reviewed over five years.
Enforced PCI DSS, SOC 2, and SOX compliance using Cloud Custodian, AWS Config Rules, and SCPs; directly supported US and Japan audit and remediation cycles.
Automated secrets and certificate lifecycle (HashiCorp Vault PKI, AppRole, OIDC) eliminating manual rotation toil across the firewall and infrastructure fleet.
Operated full observability stack — Splunk (12+ years), CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, GuardDuty — dashboards, anomaly detection, and automated triage runbooks across all environments.
Senior technical lead on global team of 20+; mentored engineers through architecture decisions and code review; contributed to annual roadmap and budget planning.

experience.title: Senior Cloud Engineer — Platform Security & Governance
bullets: Architected and managed 100+ AWS accounts and 20+ Azure subscriptions (plus OCI) from the ground up — defining account structure, security baselines, cost allocation, and network topology in partnership with business units across the organization.
Built structured AWS Organization using Control Tower and custom CDK/Python account vending automation, enforcing security posture and compliance from day one for every new account.
Designed hub-spoke AWS VPC and Azure VNET architecture with Palo Alto firewalls; delivered CloudFront CDN, Route53 DNS governance, WAF integration, and least-privilege IAM frameworks.
Deployed GuardDuty, Cloud Custodian policy-as-code, and Azure Policy to automate governance controls and generate audit evidence organization-wide.
Built all platform automation via GitHub Enterprise CI/CD using AWS CDK, CloudFormation, and Python; authored operational runbooks and architecture diagrams.
Accelerated cloud adoption for game development teams through solutions architecture, proofs-of-concept, and office hours from design through production delivery.
